title: EE SENIOR DESIGN PROJECT
description: Students work in teams to specify, design, implement and test an engineering prototype. Involves technical as well as non-technical considerations, such as manufacturability, impact on the environment, economics, adherence to engineering standards, and other real-world constraints. Projects are presented publicly by each design team in a school-wide expo.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( ELEN E3399 ) and completion of most other required EE courses.
